title: Rev-Ups (2011)
summary:
thumb|200px 
Rev-Ups were a line of vehicles with a friction motor and magnets on the chassis. The bodies are interchangeable between chassis. This series was a reboot of the earlier Micro Rev-Ups from 2003.

title: Hot Wheels Classics
summary:
200px|right
Hot Wheels Classics is an annual line of Hot Wheels cars first released in 2005. They are marketed towards adult collectors and were originally priced around $3.99 (USD). Each car features a metal base and is released in several different Spectraflame colors.

title: Key Force
summary: right|200pxKey Force was a short-lived series of transforming vehicle toys produced from 1992 to 1994. Each vehicle featured two different modes, which could be unlocked using a key provided with each vehicle. Once the vehicles were transformed, the keys could be inserted into slots in the car's bodies to fire missiles or activate various parts.
